identity.life_stage: married, two teenagers, runs a county prison ministry

engagement.interaction_backstory: He runs a Thursday chapel service inside a county facility with no wifi, no streaming, and a CD player from 2004. He downloads nothing because the site will not let him, so he plays what he can off his phone through a speaker before the signal drops. He would pay for offline tomorrow.

depth.core_contradiction: Tells forty incarcerated men every week that they are more than their worst thing, and has never told them his brother is three counties over doing eleven years.
depth.wound: He testified. It was right and it cost him the family.
depth.longing: One Thanksgiving where nobody leaves the table.
depth.faith_journey: AME Zion, usher board at twelve, trustee at thirty; the tradition holds him and the questions come at 2am.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Says "look here" before a hard truth; never raises his voice.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he forgave his brother or just filed him.

social_graph.note: runs the finances and the household; the steadier of the two
eleven years in; writes monthly; Otis has answered twice

depth.emotional_weather_default: Controlled and warm; silent for a day after visiting hours.
depth.daily_texture: Shipyard shift, Thursday chapel, the speaker that eats batteries, forty folding chairs.
depth.sensory_anchor: The lock buzzing shut behind him, every single week.
depth.living_arc: Working up to answering the third letter.
